      Before you check

      Website security, clearly explained.

      What does the free website security check include?

      A passive review of your public HTTPS homepage, basic browser-protection headers, and selected public risk signals. Your free snapshot shows observed protections, items to review, and useful next steps.

      What do I get by email?

      A private, seven-day report link that confirms your request and unlocks detailed evidence, an HTML report you can download or print, and one expanded review of up to three public pages. No payment is required.

      Does a positive result mean my website is secure?

      No. These are initial public checks with limited coverage. Hidden software, private settings, authenticated areas, and many application vulnerabilities cannot be assessed this way. Positive results can miss risks; risk flags can need further verification.

      Can this check tell whether my PHP installation is patched?

      It can compare a publicly advertised version with selected vendor advisories. Hidden versions, vendor backports, and internal settings need verification by your host or security team. It never confirms exploitability from a banner alone.

      Can Archwood help with the next steps?

      Yes. Contact us for a deeper, authorized assessment, help prioritizing findings, patching support, system audits, or cybersecurity training. You can also take the evidence to your own team or hosting provider.
